"""Sources panel of the draft tab: list, drop area and pasted text."""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.dialogs import delete_dialog
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import inspector, inspector_section
from alloq_commons.components.modal_layout import (
    MODAL_CLASS,
    modal_footer,
    modal_form_layout,
)
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import TEXT_EXTENSIONS
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.briefing_state import BriefingState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.draft_state import DraftState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.map_state import MapState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.sources_state import UPLOAD_ID, SourcesState

SOURCES_TITLE = "Quellen"
NO_SOURCES = "Noch keine Quellen. Fügen Sie Texte, E-Mails oder Dokumente hinzu."
SOURCES_HINT = (
    "Lücken wie nicht ausgewertete Bilder oder fehlende OCR bleiben sichtbar. "
    "Neue Quellen ändern einen bestehenden Entwurf nur als Vorschlag."
)
DROP_TEXT = "E-Mails, Mitschnitte, Konzepte oder Folien hier ablegen"
ADD_TEXT = "Text einfügen"
PASTE_TITLE = "Text als Quelle einfügen"
PASTE_SUBMIT = "Quelle hinzufügen"
REVOKE_TITLE = "Quelle zurückziehen"
VIEW_LABEL = "Ansehen"
GAP_LABEL = "Nicht gelesen"
NO_BLOCKS = "Aus dieser Quelle wurde noch nichts gelesen."
RETRY_LABEL = "Erneut versuchen"
READING_TITLE = "Quellen werden gelesen"
UPLOAD_ACCEPT: dict[str, Sequence] = {
    "message/rfc822": [".eml"],
    "text/*": [*TEXT_EXTENSIONS, ".html", ".htm"],
    "application/pdf": [".pdf"],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [
        ".docx"
    ],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation": [
        ".pptx"
    ],
    "audio/*": [".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a"],
}
STATUS_POLL_MS = 3000


def _read_progress() -> rx.Component:
    """Shown while sources are read; the bar moves as each one finishes."""
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.reading,
        mn.stack(
            mn.group(
                mn.text(READING_TITLE, fz="12px", fw=600),
                mn.text(SourcesState.read_label, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                justify="space-between",
            ),
            mn.progress(
                value=SourcesState.read_progress,
                size="sm",
                radius="xl",
                striped=True,
                animated=True,
            ),
            gap=6,
        ),
    )


def _drop_area() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.upload(
        mn.text(DROP_TEXT, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, ta="center"),
        id=UPLOAD_ID,
        accept=UPLOAD_ACCEPT,
        multiple=True,
        no_keyboard=False,
        on_drop=SourcesState.handle_upload(  # ty: ignore[no-matching-overload]
            rx.upload_files(upload_id=UPLOAD_ID)
        ),
        border=f"1px dashed {theme.BORDER}",
        border_radius="10px",
        padding="14px",
        cursor="pointer",
    )


def _source_row(source: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.checkbox(
            checked=source["included"],
            disabled=~source["usable"],
            on_change=lambda checked: SourcesState.toggle_source(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                source["id"], checked
            ),
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(source["name"], fw=600, fz="13px"),
            mn.text(
                source["summary"],
                fz="12px",
                c=rx.cond(source["ok"], theme.POSITIVE, theme.WARNING),
            ),
            gap=2,
            style={"minWidth": "0", "flex": "1"},
        ),
        mn.button(
            VIEW_LABEL,
            variant="subtle",
            size="compact-xs",
            on_click=SourcesState.open_viewer(source["id"]),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            source["retryable"],
            mn.button(
                RETRY_LABEL,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=SourcesState.retry_source(source["id"]),
            ),
        ),
        delete_dialog(
            REVOKE_TITLE,
            source["name"],
            SourcesState.revoke_source(source["id"]),
            icon_button=True,
            variant="subtle",
            color="gray",
            size="sm",
        ),
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="flex-start",
        p=10,
        style={"borderRadius": "8px", "background": theme.SURFACE_MUTED},
    )


def _block(block: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(block["label"], fz="11px", fw=600, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            rx.cond(
                block["speaker"] != "",
                mn.text(block["speaker"], fz="11px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            ),
            rx.cond(
                block["gap"],
                mn.badge(GAP_LABEL, color="yellow", variant="light", size="xs"),
            ),
            gap=8,
        ),
        mn.text(
            block["text"],
            fz="13px",
            lh="1.5",
            c=rx.cond(block["gap"], theme.WARNING, theme.TEXT),
        ),
        gap=2,
        py=6,
        style={"borderTop": f"1px solid {theme.SEPARATOR}"},
    )


def _viewer_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        mn.stack(
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.viewer_blocks.length() > 0,
                mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.viewer_blocks, _block), gap=0),
                mn.text(NO_BLOCKS, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            ),
            gap=8,
        ),
        title=SourcesState.viewer_title,
        opened=SourcesState.viewer_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_viewer,
        size="lg",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def _paste_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.stack(
                mn.text_input(
                    name="title",
                    label="Bezeichnung",
                    placeholder="z.B. Notizen aus dem Telefonat",
                    custom_attrs={"maxLength": 255},
                ),
                mn.textarea(
                    name="text",
                    label="Text",
                    required=True,
                    autosize=True,
                    min_rows=8,
                    max_rows=16,
                ),
                gap="md",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(PASTE_SUBMIT, SourcesState.close_paste),
            on_submit=SourcesState.add_pasted_text,
            reset_on_submit=True,
        ),
        title=PASTE_TITLE,
        opened=SourcesState.paste_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_paste,
        size="lg",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def sources_panel() -> rx.Component:
    return inspector(
        inspector_section(
            SOURCES_TITLE,
            mn.group(
                mn.button(
                    ADD_TEXT,
                    variant="subtle",
                    size="compact-sm",
                    on_click=SourcesState.open_paste,
                ),
                justify="flex-end",
            ),
            _drop_area(),
            _read_progress(),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.is_empty,
                mn.text(NO_SOURCES, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.sources, _source_row), gap=6),
            ),
            mn.text(SOURCES_HINT, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, lh="1.5"),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.has_working,
                rx.moment(
                    interval=STATUS_POLL_MS,
                    on_change=[
                        SourcesState.load_sources,
                        MapState.load_map,
                        BriefingState.load_briefing,
                        DraftState.load_overview,
                    ],
                    display="none",
                ),
            ),
        ),
        _paste_modal(),
        _viewer_modal(),
        label=SOURCES_TITLE,
    )

"""Sources panel of the draft tab: list, drop area and pasted text."""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.dialogs import delete_dialog
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import inspector, inspector_section
from alloq_commons.components.modal_layout import (
    MODAL_CLASS,
    modal_footer,
    modal_form_layout,
)
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import TEXT_EXTENSIONS
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.briefing_state import BriefingState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.draft_state import DraftState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.map_state import MapState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.sources_state import UPLOAD_ID, SourcesState

SOURCES_TITLE = "Quellen"
NO_SOURCES = "Noch keine Quellen. Fügen Sie Texte, E-Mails oder Dokumente hinzu."
SOURCES_HINT = (
    "Lücken wie nicht ausgewertete Bilder oder fehlende OCR bleiben sichtbar. "
    "Neue Quellen ändern einen bestehenden Entwurf nur als Vorschlag."
)
DROP_TEXT = "E-Mails, Mitschnitte, Konzepte oder Folien hier ablegen"
ADD_TEXT = "Text einfügen"
PASTE_TITLE = "Text als Quelle einfügen"
PASTE_SUBMIT = "Quelle hinzufügen"
REVOKE_TITLE = "Quelle zurückziehen"
VIEW_LABEL = "Ansehen"
GAP_LABEL = "Nicht gelesen"
NO_BLOCKS = "Aus dieser Quelle wurde noch nichts gelesen."
RETRY_LABEL = "Erneut versuchen"
READING_TITLE = "Quellen werden gelesen"
UPLOAD_ACCEPT: dict[str, Sequence] = {
    "message/rfc822": [".eml"],
    "text/*": [*TEXT_EXTENSIONS, ".html", ".htm"],
    "application/pdf": [".pdf"],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [
        ".docx"
    ],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation": [
        ".pptx"
    ],
    "audio/*": [".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a"],
}
STATUS_POLL_MS = 3000


def _read_progress() -> rx.Component:
    """Shown while sources are read; the bar moves as each one finishes."""
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.reading,
        mn.stack(
            mn.group(
                mn.text(READING_TITLE, fz="12px", fw=600),
                mn.text(SourcesState.read_label, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                justify="space-between",
            ),
            mn.progress(
                value=SourcesState.read_progress,
                size="sm",
                radius="xl",
                striped=True,
                animated=True,
            ),
            gap=6,
        ),
    )


def _drop_area() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.upload(
        mn.text(DROP_TEXT, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, ta="center"),
        id=UPLOAD_ID,
        accept=UPLOAD_ACCEPT,
        multiple=True,
        no_keyboard=False,
        on_drop=SourcesState.handle_upload(  # ty: ignore[no-matching-overload]
            rx.upload_files(upload_id=UPLOAD_ID)
        ),
        border=f"1px dashed {theme.BORDER}",
        border_radius="10px",
        padding="14px",
        cursor="pointer",
    )


def _source_row(source: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.checkbox(
            checked=source["included"],
            disabled=~source["usable"],
            on_change=lambda checked: SourcesState.toggle_source(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                source["id"], checked
            ),
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(source["name"], fw=600, fz="13px"),
            mn.text(
                source["summary"],
                fz="12px",
                c=rx.cond(source["ok"], theme.POSITIVE, theme.WARNING),
            ),
            gap=2,
            style={"minWidth": "0", "flex": "1"},
        ),
        mn.button(
            VIEW_LABEL,
            variant="subtle",
            size="compact-xs",
            on_click=SourcesState.open_viewer(source["id"]),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            source["retryable"],
            mn.button(
                RETRY_LABEL,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=SourcesState.retry_source(source["id"]),
            ),
        ),
        delete_dialog(
            REVOKE_TITLE,
            source["name"],
            SourcesState.revoke_source(source["id"]),
            icon_button=True,
            variant="subtle",
            color="gray",
            size="sm",
        ),
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="flex-start",
        p=10,
        style={"borderRadius": "8px", "background": theme.SURFACE_MUTED},
    )


def _block(block: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(block["label"], fz="11px", fw=600, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            rx.cond(
                block["speaker"] != "",
                mn.text(block["speaker"], fz="11px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            ),
            rx.cond(
                block["gap"],
                mn.badge(GAP_LABEL, color="yellow", variant="light", size="xs"),
            ),
            gap=8,
        ),
        mn.text(
            block["text"],
            fz="13px",
            lh="1.5",
            c=rx.cond(block["gap"], theme.WARNING, theme.TEXT),
        ),
        gap=2,
        py=6,
        style={"borderTop": f"1px solid {theme.SEPARATOR}"},
    )


def _blocks() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.viewer_blocks.length() > 0,
        mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.viewer_blocks, _block), gap=0),
        mn.text(NO_BLOCKS, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
    )


def _original() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.viewer_note != "",
        mn.text(SourcesState.viewer_note, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, py=12),
        document_viewer(
            SourcesState.viewer_kind,
            SourcesState.viewer_encoded,
            SourcesState.viewer_file,
        ),
    )


def _viewer_tabs() -> rx.Component:
    """Original file and extracted text; the viewer mounts only on its tab."""
    return mn.tabs(
        mn.tabs.list(
            mn.tabs.tab(ORIGINAL_TAB, value=VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL),
            mn.tabs.tab(TEXT_TAB, value=VIEWER_TAB_TEXT),
        ),
        mn.tabs.panel(_original(), value=VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL, pt=12),
        mn.tabs.panel(_blocks(), value=VIEWER_TAB_TEXT, pt=8),
        value=SourcesState.viewer_tab,
        on_change=SourcesState.set_viewer_tab,
    )


def _viewer_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        rx.cond(SourcesState.viewer_kind != "", _viewer_tabs(), _blocks()),
        title=SourcesState.viewer_title,
        opened=SourcesState.viewer_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_viewer,
        size=rx.cond(SourcesState.viewer_kind != "", "90%", "lg"),
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def _paste_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.stack(
                mn.text_input(
                    name="title",
                    label="Bezeichnung",
                    placeholder="z.B. Notizen aus dem Telefonat",
                    custom_attrs={"maxLength": 255},
                ),
                mn.textarea(
                    name="text",
                    label="Text",
                    required=True,
                    autosize=True,
                    min_rows=8,
                    max_rows=16,
                ),
                gap="md",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(PASTE_SUBMIT, SourcesState.close_paste),
            on_submit=SourcesState.add_pasted_text,
            reset_on_submit=True,
        ),
        title=PASTE_TITLE,
        opened=SourcesState.paste_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_paste,
        size="lg",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def sources_panel() -> rx.Component:
    return inspector(
        inspector_section(
            SOURCES_TITLE,
            mn.group(
                mn.button(
                    ADD_TEXT,
                    variant="subtle",
                    size="compact-sm",
                    on_click=SourcesState.open_paste,
                ),
                justify="flex-end",
            ),
            _drop_area(),
            _read_progress(),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.is_empty,
                mn.text(NO_SOURCES, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.sources, _source_row), gap=6),
            ),
            mn.text(SOURCES_HINT, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, lh="1.5"),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.has_working,
                rx.moment(
                    interval=STATUS_POLL_MS,
                    on_change=[
                        SourcesState.load_sources,
                        MapState.load_map,
                        BriefingState.load_briefing,
                        DraftState.load_overview,
                    ],
                    display="none",
                ),
            ),
        ),
        _paste_modal(),
        _viewer_modal(),
        label=SOURCES_TITLE,
    )

"""Revoking a source: use is closed at once, content deleted, dependents flagged."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock

from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import Paragraph, ProseContent, Run
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import (
    BlobEntity,
    ChapterEntity,
    FindingDecision,
    FindingEntity,
    SourceBlockEntity,
    SourceEntity,
    SourceKind,
    SourceStatus,
    StatementEntity,
    StatementStatus,
    StatementType,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import source_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import findings
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.chapters import ChapterService
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.source_revocation import (
    REVIEW_REASON,
    revoke_source,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import (
    SourceOriginal,
    load_blocks,
    load_original,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.workspace import open_workspace
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import BlobNotFoundError, DbBlobStore
from sqlalchemy import select

NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 29, 9, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


async def _source(db, *, blob: bool = True, replaces: int | None = None) -> int:  # noqa: ANN001
    async with db.session() as session:
        blob_id = None
        if blob:
            row = BlobEntity(sha256="b" * 64, size=3, mime="text/plain", data=b"abc")
            session.add(row)
            await session.flush()
            blob_id = row.id
        source = SourceEntity(
            offer_id=1,
            kind=SourceKind.TXT,
            title="Mail",
            filename="a.txt",
            sha256="a",
            status=SourceStatus.USABLE,
            blob_id=blob_id,
            replaces_id=replaces,
        )
        session.add(source)
        await session.flush()
        session.add(
            SourceBlockEntity(
                source_id=source.id, seq=1, anchor={}, kind="text", text="geheim"
            )
        )
        return source.id


async def _block_id(db, source_id: int) -> int:  # noqa: ANN001
    async with db.session() as session:
        found = await session.scalar(
            select(SourceBlockEntity.id).where(SourceBlockEntity.source_id == source_id)
        )
    assert found is not None
    return found


async def test_revoke_deletes_content_and_flags_dependents(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    async with db.session() as session:
        await open_workspace(session, 1, "Anna")
    service = ChapterService(db.session, 1, "Anna")
    await service.open()
    await service.save(
        "management_summary",
        1,
        ProseContent(blocks=[Paragraph(runs=[Run(text="Text")])]),
    )
    source_id = await _source(db)
    block_id = await _block_id(db, source_id)
    async with db.session() as session:
        session.add(
            StatementEntity(
                offer_id=1,
                type=StatementType.FACT,
                text="Belegt",
                status=StatementStatus.PROPOSED,
                source_refs=[block_id],
            )
        )

    assert await revoke_source(db.session, 1, source_id, now=NOW)

    async with db.session() as session:
        source = await session.get(SourceEntity, source_id)
        assert source is not None
        assert source.revoked_at is not None
        assert source.blob_id is None
        assert not source.included
        assert await session.scalar(select(SourceBlockEntity)) is None
        assert await session.scalar(select(BlobEntity)) is None
        statement = await session.scalar(select(StatementEntity))
        assert statement is not None
        assert statement.needs_recheck
        chapter = await session.scalar(
            select(ChapterEntity).where(
                ChapterEntity.chapter_key == "management_summary"
            )
        )
        assert chapter is not None
        assert chapter.review_reason == REVIEW_REASON
        assert await source_repo.list_current(session, 1) == []

    await findings.run_checks(db.session, 1)
    async with db.session() as session:
        rows = (await session.scalars(select(FindingEntity))).all()
    assert any(
        r.rule == "source_revoked" and r.decision == FindingDecision.OPEN for r in rows
    )


async def test_revoke_twice_or_foreign_source_changes_nothing(db) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
    async with db.session() as session:
        await open_workspace(session, 1, "Anna")
