tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

name.description: Tool name (e.g. computer, navigate, find, form_input, read_page). browser_batch cannot be nested. A tabs_create's new tabId is only returned when the batch ends — load that tab in a later call.

input.description: That tool's input — same shape you'd pass when calling it directly. For computer items whose action is left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key or type, and for form_input items, include action_summary in the item's input, as you would when calling that tool directly.

actions.description: List of tool calls to execute sequentially. Example: [{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"left_click","ref":"ref_12"}},{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"type","text":"hello"}},{"name":"computer","input":{"action":"screenshot"}}]

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Uploaded PDF, Word and PowerPoint sources can now be viewed. When you click "Ansehen", the dialog has two tabs: "Original" shows the uploaded file using the mail-archive viewers, and "Gelesener Text" shows the extracted blocks as before. All tests pass, and I opened all three file types in your running app. Nothing is committed.

**About the page preview:** The only page preview in mail-archive is the page rail, and it appears only when a file has more than one page. I kept that rule. In demo offer 5, "Fachkonzept Abrechnung.pdf" and "Lastenheft Kundenportal.docx" have one page each, so they show no rail. "Workshop Kickoff.pptx" has two slides and shows the rail with both previews; clicking one jumps to that slide.

I did not see the rail for a PDF with several pages, because the demo offer has none. I didn't upload one, since the local setup writes to the shared database. The PDF rail is the same code as in mail-archive.

**What I built:**
- **Viewer:** a new package, [viewer/](components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/workshop/viewer/), ported from mail-archive's viewer files. The toolbar labels are in German ("Seite 1 von 3", "Folie", "Vergrößern"). The npm versions are pinned to the same ones, and nothing loads from a CDN, so the offline desktop app still works. I left out the spreadsheet viewer because the workshop doesn't accept spreadsheet uploads.
- **Styles:** a new stylesheet, [aq-viewer.css](assets/css/aq-viewer.css), uses the alloq theme colours. The viewer height is set so the dialog doesn't scroll.
- **Loading the file:** `load_original` in [sources.py](components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/workshop/services/sources.py) returns the stored file only for PDF, DOCX and PPTX sources of this offer that haven't been revoked.
- **State:** in [sources_state.py](components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/workshop/states/sources_state.py), the file goes to the browser as base64, the same way as in mail-archive. Files over 30 MB show a note instead of the viewer. Closing the dialog frees the file from memory. The new tab switch handler is on the UI-only list in the authorization test.
- **Tests:** new tests cover the service, the state and the viewer wrappers. The full suite passes with 92% coverage, and typecheck is clean. `task lint` fails only on `fcc-test.py`, an untracked file that isn't part of this change.

content.content:
"""The panel that slides in from the right over whatever was there.

One shape, one side, one size. A drawer is the gesture for *look at this
without losing your place*: the list, the header and the open mail all stay
where they were, and closing the panel puts the reader back exactly where they
pressed. A modal would take the screen for a thing that is a detail of the
message behind it.

It opens from the right because that is the direction the archive already
reads in — the list on the left, the message beside it, and one step further
right is the file on that message. From the left it would slide over the
navigation rail and read as a change of place rather than a closer look.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import appkit_mantine as mn
import reflex as rx

SLIDE_OVER_SIZE = "min(1120px, 94vw)"
"""How wide the panel is.

Wide enough for an A4 page at a readable scale, which is what most of what
arrives on mail turns out to be. Narrower and a PDF is a column of grey.

Wider than Mantine's ``xl`` since the panel started opening documents rather
than describing them. A Word document and a PDF each carry a rail of page
previews, and ``kit/viewer_shell.jsx`` puts that rail beside the
page only above 768 pixels of *container*: at ``xl`` the panel was about 800
pixels before its own padding, so every rail was an overlay and the reader had
to ask for the thing they had just opened the file to see.

The ``vw`` half is what keeps that honest on a laptop — a fixed 1120 would be
wider than the window, and Mantine would clamp it to 100% with no room left
for the page behind. Below the breakpoint the rail is still reachable; it is
one press rather than nothing.
"""

SLIDE_OVER_STYLES = {
    # A drawer's body is a plain block with padding, so a frame inside it falls
    # back to the browser's 150 pixels — the same trap `message_detail`'s
    # TABS_STYLES documents. Making the body a growing column lets whatever is
    # in it take the height that is left. Written through `styles` because
    # Mantine's own stylesheet beats a class of ours.
    "content": {"display": "flex", "flexDirection": "column"},
    "body": {
        "flex": "1 1 0%",
        "minHeight": 0,
        "display": "flex",
        "flexDirection": "column",
    },
}
"""What makes a drawer's body fill the panel instead of hugging its text."""


def slide_over(
    *children: Any,
    opened: rx.Var | bool,
    on_close: Any,
    title: rx.Var | str = "",
    **props: Any,
) -> rx.Component:
    """A panel over the page from the right, with a title and a way out.

    ``opened`` and ``on_close`` are keyword-only and required, because a
    drawer with neither is a component that can never be closed — the one
    mistake this wrapper exists to make impossible.
    """
    props.setdefault("size", SLIDE_OVER_SIZE)
    props.setdefault("padding", "lg")
    props.setdefault("keep_mounted", False)
    return mn.drawer(
        *children,
        opened=opened,
        on_close=on_close,
        title=title,
        position="right",
        # `styles` is not a declared prop on the wrapper; through `custom_attrs`
        # it reaches Mantine as the real thing rather than as a CSS key.
        custom_attrs={"styles": SLIDE_OVER_STYLES},
        **props,
    )

where they were, and closing the panel puts the reader back exactly where they
pressed. A modal would take the screen for a thing that is a detail of the
message behind it.

It opens from the right because that is the direction the archive already
reads in — the list on the left, the message beside it, and one step further
right is the file on that message. From the left it would slide over the
navigation rail and read as a change of place rather than a closer look.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import appkit_mantine as mn
import reflex as rx

SLIDE_OVER_SIZE = "min(1120px, 94vw)"
"""How wide the panel is.

Wide enough for an A4 page at a readable scale, which is what most of what
arrives on mail turns out to be. Narrower and a PDF is a column of grey.

Wider than Mantine's ``xl`` since the panel started opening documents rather
than describing them. A Word document and a PDF each carry a rail of page
previews, and ``kit/viewer_shell.jsx`` puts that rail beside the
page only above 768 pixels of *container*: at ``xl`` the panel was about 800
pixels before its own padding, so every rail was an overlay and the reader had
to ask for the thing they had just opened the file to see.

The ``vw`` half is what keeps that honest on a laptop — a fixed 1120 would be
wider than the window, and Mantine would clamp it to 100% with no room left
for the page behind. Below the breakpoint the rail is still reachable; it is
one press rather than nothing.
"""

SLIDE_OVER_STYLES = {
    # A drawer's body is a plain block with padding, so a frame inside it falls
    # back to the browser's 150 pixels — the same trap `message_detail`'s
    # TABS_STYLES documents. Making the body a growing column lets whatever is
    # in it take the height that is left. Written through `styles` because
    # Mantine's own stylesheet beats a class of ours.
    "content": {"display": "flex", "flexDirection": "column"},
    "body": {
        "flex": "1 1 0%",
        "minHeight": 0,
        "display": "flex",
        "flexDirection": "column",
    },
}
"""What makes a drawer's body fill the panel instead of hugging its text."""


def slide_over(
    *children: Any,
    opened: rx.Var | bool,
    on_close: Any,
    title: rx.Var | str = "",
    **props: Any,
) -> rx.Component:
    """A panel over the page from the right, with a title and a way out.

    ``opened`` and ``on_close`` are keyword-only and required, because a
    drawer with neither is a component that can never be closed — the one
    mistake this wrapper exists to make impossible.
    """
    props.setdefault("size", SLIDE_OVER_SIZE)
    props.setdefault("padding", "lg")
    props.setdefault("keep_mounted", False)
    return mn.drawer(
        *children,
        opened=opened,
        on_close=on_close,
        title=title,
        position="right",
        # `styles` is not a declared prop on the wrapper; through `custom_attrs`
        # it reaches Mantine as the real thing rather than as a CSS key.
        custom_attrs={"styles": SLIDE_OVER_STYLES},
        **props,
    )

"""Sources panel of the draft tab: list, drop area and pasted text."""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.dialogs import delete_dialog
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import inspector, inspector_section
from alloq_commons.components.modal_layout import (
    MODAL_CLASS,
    modal_footer,
    modal_form_layout,
)
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import TEXT_EXTENSIONS
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.briefing_state import BriefingState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.draft_state import DraftState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.map_state import MapState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.sources_state import (
    UPLOAD_ID,
    VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL,
    VIEWER_TAB_TEXT,
    SourcesState,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.viewer.viewer import document_viewer

SOURCES_TITLE = "Quellen"
NO_SOURCES = "Noch keine Quellen. Fügen Sie Texte, E-Mails oder Dokumente hinzu."
SOURCES_HINT = (
    "Lücken wie nicht ausgewertete Bilder oder fehlende OCR bleiben sichtbar. "
    "Neue Quellen ändern einen bestehenden Entwurf nur als Vorschlag."
)
DROP_TEXT = "E-Mails, Mitschnitte, Konzepte oder Folien hier ablegen"
ADD_TEXT = "Text einfügen"
PASTE_TITLE = "Text als Quelle einfügen"
PASTE_SUBMIT = "Quelle hinzufügen"
REVOKE_TITLE = "Quelle zurückziehen"
VIEW_LABEL = "Ansehen"
GAP_LABEL = "Nicht gelesen"
NO_BLOCKS = "Aus dieser Quelle wurde noch nichts gelesen."
ORIGINAL_TAB = "Original"
TEXT_TAB = "Gelesener Text"
RETRY_LABEL = "Erneut versuchen"
READING_TITLE = "Quellen werden gelesen"
UPLOAD_ACCEPT: dict[str, Sequence] = {
    "message/rfc822": [".eml"],
    "text/*": [*TEXT_EXTENSIONS, ".html", ".htm"],
    "application/pdf": [".pdf"],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [
        ".docx"
    ],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation": [
        ".pptx"
    ],
    "audio/*": [".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a"],
}
STATUS_POLL_MS = 3000


def _read_progress() -> rx.Component:
    """Shown while sources are read; the bar moves as each one finishes."""
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.reading,
        mn.stack(
            mn.group(
                mn.text(READING_TITLE, fz="12px", fw=600),
                mn.text(SourcesState.read_label, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                justify="space-between",
            ),
            mn.progress(
                value=SourcesState.read_progress,
                size="sm",
                radius="xl",
                striped=True,
                animated=True,
            ),
            gap=6,
        ),
    )


def _drop_area() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.upload(
        mn.text(DROP_TEXT, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, ta="center"),
        id=UPLOAD_ID,
        accept=UPLOAD_ACCEPT,
        multiple=True,
        no_keyboard=False,
        on_drop=SourcesState.handle_upload(  # ty: ignore[no-matching-overload]
            rx.upload_files(upload_id=UPLOAD_ID)
        ),
        border=f"1px dashed {theme.BORDER}",
        border_radius="10px",
        padding="14px",
        cursor="pointer",
    )


def _source_row(source: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.checkbox(
            checked=source["included"],
            disabled=~source["usable"],
            on_change=lambda checked: SourcesState.toggle_source(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                source["id"], checked
            ),
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(source["name"], fw=600, fz="13px"),
            mn.text(
                source["summary"],
                fz="12px",
                c=rx.cond(source["ok"], theme.POSITIVE, theme.WARNING),
            ),
            gap=2,
            style={"minWidth": "0", "flex": "1"},
        ),
        mn.button(
            VIEW_LABEL,
            variant="subtle",
            size="compact-xs",
            on_click=SourcesState.open_viewer(source["id"]),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            source["retryable"],
            mn.button(
                RETRY_LABEL,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=SourcesState.retry_source(source["id"]),
            ),
        ),
        delete_dialog(
            REVOKE_TITLE,
            source["name"],
            SourcesState.revoke_source(source["id"]),
            icon_button=True,
            variant="subtle",
            color="gray",
            size="sm",
        ),
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="flex-start",
        p=10,
        style={"borderRadius": "8px", "background": theme.SURFACE_MUTED},
    )


def _block(block: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(block["label"], fz="11px", fw=600, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            rx.cond(
                block["speaker"] != "",
                mn.text(block["speaker"], fz="11px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            ),
            rx.cond(
                block["gap"],
                mn.badge(GAP_LABEL, color="yellow", variant="light", size="xs"),
            ),
            gap=8,
        ),
        mn.text(
            block["text"],
            fz="13px",
            lh="1.5",
            c=rx.cond(block["gap"], theme.WARNING, theme.TEXT),
        ),
        gap=2,
        py=6,
        style={"borderTop": f"1px solid {theme.SEPARATOR}"},
    )


def _blocks() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.viewer_blocks.length() > 0,
        mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.viewer_blocks, _block), gap=0),
        mn.text(NO_BLOCKS, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
    )


def _original() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.viewer_note != "",
        mn.text(SourcesState.viewer_note, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, py=12),
        document_viewer(
            SourcesState.viewer_kind,
            SourcesState.viewer_encoded,
            SourcesState.viewer_file,
        ),
    )


def _viewer_tabs() -> rx.Component:
    """Original file and extracted text; the viewer mounts only on its tab."""
    return mn.tabs(
        mn.tabs.list(
            mn.tabs.tab(ORIGINAL_TAB, value=VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL),
            mn.tabs.tab(TEXT_TAB, value=VIEWER_TAB_TEXT),
        ),
        mn.tabs.panel(_original(), value=VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL, pt=12),
        mn.tabs.panel(_blocks(), value=VIEWER_TAB_TEXT, pt=8),
        value=SourcesState.viewer_tab,
        on_change=SourcesState.set_viewer_tab,
    )


def _viewer_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        rx.cond(SourcesState.viewer_kind != "", _viewer_tabs(), _blocks()),
        title=SourcesState.viewer_title,
        opened=SourcesState.viewer_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_viewer,
        size=rx.cond(SourcesState.viewer_kind != "", "90%", "lg"),
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def _paste_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.stack(
                mn.text_input(
                    name="title",
                    label="Bezeichnung",
                    placeholder="z.B. Notizen aus dem Telefonat",
                    custom_attrs={"maxLength": 255},
                ),
                mn.textarea(
                    name="text",
                    label="Text",
                    required=True,
                    autosize=True,
                    min_rows=8,
                    max_rows=16,
                ),
                gap="md",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(PASTE_SUBMIT, SourcesState.close_paste),
            on_submit=SourcesState.add_pasted_text,
            reset_on_submit=True,
        ),
        title=PASTE_TITLE,
        opened=SourcesState.paste_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_paste,
        size="lg",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def sources_panel() -> rx.Component:
    return inspector(
        inspector_section(
            SOURCES_TITLE,
            mn.group(
                mn.button(
                    ADD_TEXT,
                    variant="subtle",
                    size="compact-sm",
                    on_click=SourcesState.open_paste,
                ),
                justify="flex-end",
            ),
            _drop_area(),
            _read_progress(),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.is_empty,
                mn.text(NO_SOURCES, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.sources, _source_row), gap=6),
            ),
            mn.text(SOURCES_HINT, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, lh="1.5"),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.has_working,
                rx.moment(
                    interval=STATUS_POLL_MS,
                    on_change=[
                        SourcesState.load_sources,
                        MapState.load_map,
                        BriefingState.load_briefing,
                        DraftState.load_overview,
                    ],
                    display="none",
                ),
            ),
        ),
        _paste_modal(),
        _viewer_modal(),
        label=SOURCES_TITLE,
    )

"""Sources panel of the draft tab: list, drop area and pasted text."""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.dialogs import delete_dialog
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import inspector, inspector_section
from alloq_commons.components.modal_layout import (
    MODAL_CLASS,
    modal_footer,
    modal_form_layout,
)
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import TEXT_EXTENSIONS
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.briefing_state import BriefingState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.draft_state import DraftState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.map_state import MapState
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.sources_state import (
    UPLOAD_ID,
    VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL,
    VIEWER_TAB_TEXT,
    SourcesState,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.viewer.viewer import document_viewer

SOURCES_TITLE = "Quellen"
NO_SOURCES = "Noch keine Quellen. Fügen Sie Texte, E-Mails oder Dokumente hinzu."
SOURCES_HINT = (
    "Lücken wie nicht ausgewertete Bilder oder fehlende OCR bleiben sichtbar. "
    "Neue Quellen ändern einen bestehenden Entwurf nur als Vorschlag."
)
DROP_TEXT = "E-Mails, Mitschnitte, Konzepte oder Folien hier ablegen"
ADD_TEXT = "Text einfügen"
PASTE_TITLE = "Text als Quelle einfügen"
PASTE_SUBMIT = "Quelle hinzufügen"
REVOKE_TITLE = "Quelle zurückziehen"
VIEW_LABEL = "Ansehen"
GAP_LABEL = "Nicht gelesen"
NO_BLOCKS = "Aus dieser Quelle wurde noch nichts gelesen."
ORIGINAL_TAB = "Original"
TEXT_TAB = "Gelesener Text"
RETRY_LABEL = "Erneut versuchen"
READING_TITLE = "Quellen werden gelesen"
UPLOAD_ACCEPT: dict[str, Sequence] = {
    "message/rfc822": [".eml"],
    "text/*": [*TEXT_EXTENSIONS, ".html", ".htm"],
    "application/pdf": [".pdf"],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [
        ".docx"
    ],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation": [
        ".pptx"
    ],
    "audio/*": [".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a"],
}
STATUS_POLL_MS = 3000


def _read_progress() -> rx.Component:
    """Shown while sources are read; the bar moves as each one finishes."""
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.reading,
        mn.stack(
            mn.group(
                mn.text(READING_TITLE, fz="12px", fw=600),
                mn.text(SourcesState.read_label, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                justify="space-between",
            ),
            mn.progress(
                value=SourcesState.read_progress,
                size="sm",
                radius="xl",
                striped=True,
                animated=True,
            ),
            gap=6,
        ),
    )


def _drop_area() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.upload(
        mn.text(DROP_TEXT, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, ta="center"),
        id=UPLOAD_ID,
        accept=UPLOAD_ACCEPT,
        multiple=True,
        no_keyboard=False,
        on_drop=SourcesState.handle_upload(  # ty: ignore[no-matching-overload]
            rx.upload_files(upload_id=UPLOAD_ID)
        ),
        border=f"1px dashed {theme.BORDER}",
        border_radius="10px",
        padding="14px",
        cursor="pointer",
    )


def _source_row(source: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.checkbox(
            checked=source["included"],
            disabled=~source["usable"],
            on_change=lambda checked: SourcesState.toggle_source(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                source["id"], checked
            ),
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(source["name"], fw=600, fz="13px"),
            mn.text(
                source["summary"],
                fz="12px",
                c=rx.cond(source["ok"], theme.POSITIVE, theme.WARNING),
            ),
            gap=2,
            style={"minWidth": "0", "flex": "1"},
        ),
        mn.button(
            VIEW_LABEL,
            variant="subtle",
            size="compact-xs",
            on_click=SourcesState.open_viewer(source["id"]),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            source["retryable"],
            mn.button(
                RETRY_LABEL,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=SourcesState.retry_source(source["id"]),
            ),
        ),
        delete_dialog(
            REVOKE_TITLE,
            source["name"],
            SourcesState.revoke_source(source["id"]),
            icon_button=True,
            variant="subtle",
            color="gray",
            size="sm",
        ),
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="flex-start",
        p=10,
        style={"borderRadius": "8px", "background": theme.SURFACE_MUTED},
    )


def _block(block: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(block["label"], fz="11px", fw=600, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            rx.cond(
                block["speaker"] != "",
                mn.text(block["speaker"], fz="11px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            ),
            rx.cond(
                block["gap"],
                mn.badge(GAP_LABEL, color="yellow", variant="light", size="xs"),
            ),
            gap=8,
        ),
        mn.text(
            block["text"],
            fz="13px",
            lh="1.5",
            c=rx.cond(block["gap"], theme.WARNING, theme.TEXT),
        ),
        gap=2,
        py=6,
        style={"borderTop": f"1px solid {theme.SEPARATOR}"},
    )


def _blocks() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        rx.cond(
            SourcesState.viewer_blocks.length() > 0,
            mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.viewer_blocks, _block), gap=0),
            mn.text(NO_BLOCKS, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
        ),
        class_name="alloq-modal-scroll",
    )


def _original() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.cond(
        SourcesState.viewer_note != "",
        mn.text(SourcesState.viewer_note, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, p=18),
        document_viewer(
            SourcesState.viewer_kind,
            SourcesState.viewer_encoded,
            SourcesState.viewer_file,
        ),
    )


def _viewer_tabs() -> rx.Component:
    """Original file and extracted text; the viewer mounts only on its tab."""
    return mn.tabs(
        mn.tabs.list(
            mn.tabs.tab(ORIGINAL_TAB, value=VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL),
            mn.tabs.tab(TEXT_TAB, value=VIEWER_TAB_TEXT),
            px=26,
        ),
        mn.tabs.panel(_original(), value=VIEWER_TAB_ORIGINAL, p="12px 18px 18px"),
        mn.tabs.panel(_blocks(), value=VIEWER_TAB_TEXT),
        value=SourcesState.viewer_tab,
        on_change=SourcesState.set_viewer_tab,
        custom_attrs={"styles": VIEWER_TABS_STYLES},
    )


def _viewer_drawer() -> rx.Component:
    """Slides in from the right, wide enough for the page rail beside a page."""
    has_original = SourcesState.viewer_kind != ""
    return mn.drawer(
        rx.cond(has_original, _viewer_tabs(), _blocks()),
        title=SourcesState.viewer_title,
        opened=SourcesState.viewer_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_viewer,
        position="right",
        size=rx.cond(has_original, VIEWER_DRAWER_SIZE, "lg"),
        offset="15px",
        radius="md",
        keep_mounted=False,
        class_name=DRAWER_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.3, "blur": 3},
    )


def _paste_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.stack(
                mn.text_input(
                    name="title",
                    label="Bezeichnung",
                    placeholder="z.B. Notizen aus dem Telefonat",
                    custom_attrs={"maxLength": 255},
                ),
                mn.textarea(
                    name="text",
                    label="Text",
                    required=True,
                    autosize=True,
                    min_rows=8,
                    max_rows=16,
                ),
                gap="md",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(PASTE_SUBMIT, SourcesState.close_paste),
            on_submit=SourcesState.add_pasted_text,
            reset_on_submit=True,
        ),
        title=PASTE_TITLE,
        opened=SourcesState.paste_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_paste,
        size="lg",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def sources_panel() -> rx.Component:
    return inspector(
        inspector_section(
            SOURCES_TITLE,
            mn.group(
                mn.button(
                    ADD_TEXT,
                    variant="subtle",
                    size="compact-sm",
                    on_click=SourcesState.open_paste,
                ),
                justify="flex-end",
            ),
            _drop_area(),
            _read_progress(),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.is_empty,
                mn.text(NO_SOURCES, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.sources, _source_row), gap=6),
            ),
            mn.text(SOURCES_HINT, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, lh="1.5"),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.has_working,
                rx.moment(
                    interval=STATUS_POLL_MS,
                    on_change=[
                        SourcesState.load_sources,
                        MapState.load_map,
                        BriefingState.load_briefing,
                        DraftState.load_overview,
                    ],
                    display="none",
                ),
            ),
        ),
        _paste_modal(),
        _viewer_modal(),
        label=SOURCES_TITLE,
    )

The viewer now slides in from the right, and the area around the pages follows dark mode. I checked PPTX and DOCX in the running app in dark and light mode, and all tests pass. Nothing is committed.

**Dark mode:** The PDF and Word viewers already used the theme color around the pages. The slide deck library brings its own beige colors, and those were the light background you saw. In [aq-viewer.css](assets/css/aq-viewer.css) they now use the alloq theme colors. In dark mode the area around the pages is dark gray, and in light mode it is light gray. The pages themselves stay white, as in mail-archive.

**Slide-in panel:** In [sources_panel.py](components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/workshop/components/sources_panel.py) the dialog is now a panel on the right, styled like the other alloq drawers (the dashboard detail drawer, for example).
- It is up to 1120 px wide, the same width mail-archive uses, so the page rail fits beside the page.
- The tabs and the viewer fill the panel's full height.
- Sources without an original file, such as e-mails or pasted text, open in a narrower panel that shows only the extracted text.

One thing I noticed: a slide deck opens at 100 %, and a standard slide is 960 px wide. That is wider than the page area when the rail is open, so the slide scrolls sideways. mail-archive behaves the same way.

name: react-pptx-fit-mode
description: "@extend-ai/react-pptx 0.2.0 fitMode only knows contain/none; contain mis-measures padded viewport"
metadata:
  type: reference
---

`@extend-ai/react-pptx@0.2.0` `fitMode` accepts only `"contain"` or `"none"`. Mail-archive's `fitMode="width"` silently means "none" (slides open at natural 960px and overflow). With `"contain"`, scale = min(1, viewport.clientWidth / slideWidth) × zoom/100, but clientWidth includes `.rpv-viewport`'s own 34px padding, so slides still overflow by 68px. Fix used in alloq (2026-10-25, `assets/css/aq-viewer.css`): `.aq-viewer .rpv-viewport { width: auto; padding: 24px 0; margin-inline: 24px; }`.

**How to apply:** keep that override when touching the deck viewer; the same bug still exists in mail-archive. See [[workshop-viewer-rail-single-page]].

content.text:
The viewer now fills the whole slide-in panel with no card frame, and slide decks open fitted to the panel width. I checked the deck in the running app: the slide fills the page area exactly, with no sideways scrolling. The viewer and sources tests pass. Nothing is committed.

**Full space:** In [aq-viewer.css](assets/css/aq-viewer.css) I removed the viewer's border and rounded corners, and in [sources_panel.py](components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/workshop/components/sources_panel.py) I removed the padding around the "Original" tab. The viewer now runs edge to edge below the tabs.

**Slide decks fitted to width:** Two things were wrong, and mail-archive has both:
- **Wrong setting:** mail-archive sets `fitMode="width"`, but the deck library only knows `"contain"` and `"none"`. It treated `"width"` as `"none"`, so slides opened at full size. I changed it to `"contain"` in [viewer_pptx.jsx](components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/workshop/viewer/viewer_pptx.jsx). 100 % now means "fitted to the width", and zooming in or out starts from there.
- **Library bug:** even with `"contain"`, the library sizes slides from the viewport width including its own 34 px padding, so slides were still 68 px too wide. I moved that spacing out of the viewport's padding in the CSS, so the slide fits exactly.

Mail-archive still has both problems. Fixing it there is two small edits: the same `fitMode` change in its `viewer_pptx.jsx` and the same CSS rule. Tell me if you want them.

def _source_row(source: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    """Name and actions in one line; the status below uses the full card width."""
    return mn.stack(
        _source_head(source),
        mn.text(
            source["summary"],
            fz="12px",
            c=rx.cond(source["ok"], theme.POSITIVE, theme.WARNING),
        ),
        gap=6,
        p=10,
        style={"borderRadius": "8px", "background": theme.SURFACE_MUTED},
    )


def _source_head(source: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.checkbox(
            checked=source["included"],
            disabled=~source["usable"],
            on_change=lambda checked: SourcesState.toggle_source(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                source["id"], checked
            ),
        ),
        mn.text(
            source["name"],
            fw=600,
            fz="13px",
            style={"minWidth": "0", "flex": "1", "overflowWrap": "anywhere"},
        ),
        mn.action_icon(
            rx.icon("eye", size=16),
            variant="subtle",
            color="gray",
            size="sm",
            on_click=SourcesState.open_viewer(source["id"]),
            aria_label=VIEW_LABEL,
            custom_attrs={"title": VIEW_LABEL},
        ),
        rx.cond(
            source["retryable"],
            mn.button(
                RETRY_LABEL,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=SourcesState.retry_source(source["id"]),
            ),
        ),
        delete_dialog(
            REVOKE_TITLE,
            source["name"],
            SourcesState.revoke_source(source["id"]),
            icon_button=True,
            variant="subtle",
            color="gray",
            size="sm",
        ),
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="flex-start",
    )


def _block(block: ObjectVar[dict[str, Any]]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(block["label"], fz="11px", fw=600, c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
            rx.cond(
                block["speaker"] != "",
